subject: Renewal: Hightide Labs - staggered commit & temporary price shelter
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@hightide.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@hightide.com>, Liam Hayes <liam.hayes@hightide.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal needs + temporary pricehold request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last year — Hightide’s teams are looking great on the integration. We’ve started our renewal discussion internally and have a near-term ask: volume is trending up ahead of our Q4 product launch, and we need a predictable floor on pricing while we finalize our commit levels.

Specifically: can Redwood provide a temporary pricehold through Aug 31 if we sign a staggered multi-quarter commit now (we're targeting a 6–9 month staged uplift, with an initial true-up in 60 days)? Also looking to negotiate a one-time onboarding credit for the increased throughput (roughly $40k–$60k).

I’ve attached a short request doc that outlines our expected month-by-month uplift and a proposed PO cadence. Can you share a mutual action plan and any internal approvals you’ll need so procurement can calendar approvals?

Attachments: Hightide_Renewal_Request.pdf (2 pages)

—Emma
Emma Collins
Head of Procurement, Hightide Labs
emma.collins@hightide.com
+1 415-555-0118
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@hightide.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal needs + temporary pricehold request

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We can absolutely structure a staggered commit with a transient pricehold, but I want to align on a few concrete pieces so I can get Sales Ops and Finance to sign off:

- Proposed commit cadence you’re open to (month-by-month expected tokens / v2 calls). If you can confirm the numbers in the PDF that helps.
- Target commitment term (we usually see 6/9/12 month options).
- Whether the onboarding credit should be applied up-front or as a bill credit across the first two invoices.

High level proposal from our side (subject to Ops/legal redline):
- Temporary pricehold through 2027-08-31 on current list rates if a staged commit is signed by 2027-06-30.
- Staggered commit: 0–30 days = baseline + 25% uplift; 31–90 days = baseline + 60% uplift; remainder = baseline + agreed long-term uplift.
- One-time onboarding credit: $50,000 applied as invoice credit (or can be split 60/40 if you prefer).

I’m looping in Kimberly (Sales Ops) and David (Finance) to run a quick approval and produce a short mutual action plan / term-sheet. If that looks good to you, we’ll circulate a redline and DocuSign link.

Next step: Kimberly and David, can you confirm whether a 60-day true-up cadence + $50k credit is acceptable from finance/ops?

Best,
Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Hightide renewal — pricehold & credit ask (deal HT-2027-043)

Kimberly / David —

Emma at Hightide (cc’d earlier) wants a temporary pricehold through Aug 31 if they sign a staggered commit by 6/30. They’ve asked for $40–60k onboarding credit; I’ve proposed $50k invoice credit.

Risks/notes:
- Hightide is increasing usage ahead of a major product launch; likely to convert to higher sustained run-rate post-Q4.
- We should protect unit economics by making the pricehold contingent on a signed MA and a clear true-up cadence (60 days).

Ask: please review the attached draft term-sheet and confirm whether finance/legal can approve a $50k credit and a pricehold until 2027-08-31 conditioned on the staged commit. If you prefer a split-credit (30/70) or a short invoice deferral instead of a straight credit, flag it here — I’ll negotiate with procurement.

Attachment: proposed-term-sheet-redline.pdf (term sheet + conditional clauses)

I’ll hold off sending the external doc until Ops and Finance give the green light.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Hightide renewal — pricehold & credit ask (deal HT-2027-043)

Jordan — quick read on this: Finance is willing to support the $50k onboarding credit if we lock a minimum aggregate commit and limit exposure with a staged true-up. Suggested changes below: 

- Make pricehold conditional on an initial signed MOU / exhibit that includes a minimum aggregate commit of $480k over 9 months (this ensures we don’t under-index).
- Apply the $50k as a split: $30k invoice credit + $20k service credit (implementation hours) — this eases cashflow pressure on Redwood and keeps a delivery tie to the uplift.
- If Hightide requests net-60 PO terms, require a short-term invoice deferral (max 30 days) rather than full net-60 for the credit portion.

I updated the redline and added a recommended fallback clause should their actuals miss the staged targets (pro-rata clawback of credits). I also attached a HubSpot checklist so CS can coordinate the onboarding hours.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/HT-2027-043
Attachment: SOW-Hightide-Q3.xlsx

If that’s acceptable I’ll push the redline and the MA plan to Emma today. 

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Hightide renewal — agreed staggered commit, credits, and DocuSign

Emma — appreciate the patience while we coordinated internally. Summary of the agreed terms below (we’ve also attached the redlined MA and SOW):

Agreed commercial summary (HT-2027-043):
- Temporary pricehold: Redwood will hold current list rates for Hightide through 2027-08-31, contingent on an executed mutual action exhibit signed by 2027-06-30.
- Staggered commit: 9-month staged commit; minimum aggregate commit $480,000 over 9 months (detailed month-by-month volumes in the attached SOW). True-ups every 60 days.
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 total applied as $30,000 invoice credit + $20,000 service credit for implementation hours (CS to schedule).
- Credit clawback: pro-rata clawback if staged targets are not met after the 90-day ramp window (standard language in redline).
- PO & payment: please issue PO referencing deal HT-2027-043. If you require net-60, we can support invoice deferral of up to 30 days on the credit portion only.

Next steps:
1) I’m sending the DocuSign envelope now: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-hightide-renewal
2) Please sign the exhibit and return a PO (procurement@hightide.com).
3) Kimberly/CS will reach out to schedule onboarding hours tied to the $20k service credit.

Attachments: proposed-term-sheet-redline.pdf, SOW-Hightide-Q3.xlsx

If you want a short call to run through the MA plan before signing, happy to schedule 30 minutes this week.

Thanks — excited to keep scaling with you.
